eas_text: A civil authority has issued A LAW ENFORCEMENT WARNING for the following counties or areas: Tuscarawas, OH; at 5:25 PM on AUG 28, 2025 Effective until 1:25 AM AUG 29, 2025. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Tuscarawas Alert: Dover police request the residents in the area of Canal Rd and East Front Street to shelter in place until further notice. Stay clear from and lock doors and windows. A follow up message will be sent when the area has been cleared
